details: This package is a staged downloader/loader disguised as a "Test pipeline utilities" library; its unpacked size jumped from 346 bytes in prior versions to 6.35MB, which is the hidden payload. It ships three execution paths that run without user action: a binding.gyp whose only build target uses node-gyp command substitution to execute `node index.js` during install (output redirected to /dev/null), and an index.js that is a single 6.3MB line of obfuscated code. index.js rot13-decodes an embedded character-code array and eval()s the result; the decoded source is an AES-128-GCM decryptor (require("node:crypto"), createDecipheriv with a hardcoded key, IV and 16-byte auth tag) that decrypts a ~3MB hex ciphertext blob embedded in the same file. The decrypted plaintext is then either written to the stdin of a spawned interpreter (process.execPath / Bun.spawn with piped stdio) or executed directly via eval. The package also depends on the "bun" runtime, consistent with bootstrapping a non-standard JS runtime to run the hidden stage. The payload's URLs, hosts and commands are inside the encrypted blob and are not visible in plaintext; no plaintext C2 host, IP or credential path appears in the shipped files.
